title: Nvidia Just Sent a Massive Signal to AI Stock Investors
creator: Couch Investor
source_note: Detailed summary generated from video captions
summary: Couch Investor and Motley Fool guest Neil dissect Nvidia's first earnings without founder Jensen Huang. Q3 was a huge beat: revenue $115.8bn (up over 100% year over year, roughly a $3bn beat versus the highest Wall Street estimate), data-centre revenue $107.6bn, non-GAAP gross margin 74.9%, EPS $2.68 and free cash flow $43.8bn. Q4 guidance of $130bn also beat, and the FY28 growth outlook was raised from 70% to 75% — Couch's best-case scenario. Interim CEO Colette Kress reaffirmed guidance and the AI-ecosystem commitments, which the pair read as 'business as usual' so far, though the CEO question stays open for weeks or months. They clarify the guarantees: maximum exposure $118bn, $32bn of neocloud agreements running 2028-2032, with nothing drawn yet, and supply/capacity commitments of about $390bn, roughly $210bn landing in FY28 on the Vera Rubin ramp. China revenue is excluded from guidance and Hopper shipments have stopped. Nvidia has now closed seven straight weeks lower, with weekly RSI at its lowest since October 2022. Couch stays 'extremely bullish' on neoclouds such as CoreWeave — token demand keeps growing and whoever has active power wins — and on the semiconductor supply chain. Calls: NVDA BUY reiterated, CRWV BUY reiterated. Note: auto-captions garble some names (Kress as 'Klet Crest').
